schedule:

8. 投稿國內外之學術會議或期刊論文。
materials: 相關搜尋工具與圖書館資源之運用

outline:
學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目,在教授個別指導下,進行實驗之研究,以培養學生尋找相關資料,文獻及獨立研究的訓練,並將其研究成果撰寫成報告並公開發表練習。本專題著重在太陽能電池組裝的實驗技巧。藉由小分子無添加劑電洞傳輸層結構與鈣鈦礦太陽能電池效率相關性的探討培養學生動手組裝元件、動腦探究小分子結構的奇蹟並激勵學生產生獨立解決問題的能力，進而養成發掘更多的問題的能力，而成為自我學習的動機。
To make students able to carry out independent study. Students will be assigned a short topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, and final report presentation are necessary for this course. The specific topic focuses on the experimental skills of solar cell assembly. Through the discussion of the correlation between the structure of the small molecule additive-free hole transport layer and the efficiency of perovskite solar cells, students are trained to assemble solar device, to explore the miracles of small molecule structures, and to develop independent problem-solving abilities. The motivation to solve a problem becomes the motivation to learn.

13~18周: 數據結果統整討論分析/學期末報告
